finding_key: docs/design/slides/slides-pptx-export.md::design doc claims the shared `torgbhexcolor` normalizes `<a:srgbclr val>` in `color.ts`, but the implementation only normalizes at the two call sites in `export/pptx/text.ts`
evidence: The doc edit in docs/design/slides/slides-pptx-export.md places the toRgbHexColor normalization under the "Colors (color.ts)" bullet as a property of the `<a:srgbClr val>` sink, but the diff (given as complete) modifies only packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts, where storedColorToThemeColor normalizes docs StoredColor values before building a ThemeColor. text.ts's own comment at this commit states "colorChildXml only strips `#` and upper-cases", confirming color.ts is unchanged and other srgbClr producers (shape fills, gradients, theme colors) bypass the normalizer. The doc therefore overstates the sink-level "injection-proof by construction" guarantee; the claim correctly identifies the doc/implementation mismatch. Impact is limited since non-text srgb values come from typed model paths and are still XML-escaped, so this is a minor doc-accuracy/design-fit defect.
